items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Disguise Kit (Elite)
items.description: This small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and a few simple wigs. You usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the Deception skill. An elite disguise kit adds a +1 item bonus to relevant checks. If you've crafted a large number of disguises, you can replenish your cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of your disguise kit. You can draw and replace a worn disguise kit as part of the action that uses it.

items.name: Clothing (Fine)
items.description: Fine clothing, suitable for a noble or royal, is made with expensive fabrics, precious metals, and intricate patterns.

items.name: Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator)
items.description:
You need a thieves' toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. An infiltrator thieves' toolkit add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' toolkit is broken, you can repair it by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

generalAbilities.name: Flamboyant Performance
generalAbilities.description: A flamboyant thief's attempts to Steal don't automatically fail even if a creature is in combat or on guard. While being observed, the thief gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Create a Diversion or Feint and to Thievery checks to Palm an object or Steal. However, they are compelled to leave a tangible sign of their presence, such as a calling card or symbol—often in place of a stolen item.

generalAbilities.name: Vanishing Act
generalAbilities.description: The flamboyant thief can Hide and Sneak even without having cover or being Concealed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Dramatic Entrance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The flamboyant thief rolls initiative

Effect The flamboyant thief draws all eyes to them. They attempt a performance|defense:will check, comparing the result against the Will DC of any number of creatures within 120 feet. Each creature the thief succeeds against is Fascinated with the thief until the end of the thief's next turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: I Say When I'm Here
defensiveAbilities.description: When any detection, revelation, or scrying magic would reveal the flamboyant thief, the thief becomes aware of it and can attempt to counteract the magic with a counteract rank of 8th level and using their Stealth as their counteract modifier.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The flamboyant thief is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see.

Effect The flamboyant thief gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dancing Dagger
offensiveAbilities.description: The flamboyant thief can Step, attempt a melee dagger Strike, and attempt a ranged dagger Strike, taking the actions in any order. Both Strikes count toward the thief's multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dramatic Exit
offensiveAbilities.description: The flamboyant thief throws down their smoke ball, then Hides, then Sneaks up to three times with a +2 circumstance bonus to their Stealth checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spectacular Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: All the flamboyant thief's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage or 6d6 if the target is Fascinated with the thief. After the thief Strikes a creature, that creature becomes fascinated with the thief until the end of the thief's next turn.
